summary_md: **Carol Man ([@ManWenzhu51484](https://x.com/ManWenzhu51484/status/2116070605468627288))** summarizes *HSPR* ([arXiv 2610.24611](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24611)): at a 10% budget on SWE-bench Pro a mid-range task subset kept model ordering (Kendall τ≈0.97) yet underestimated full scores by about 23 points on average, so cheap evals can rank correctly while misleading release gates.
